name: AmazingHand
summary: A fully 3D-printable four-finger hand from the Reachy team, open-sourced in July 2025 for under €200 in parts. Each finger has two phalanxes on a parallel mechanism driven by two Feetech SCS0009 servos housed in the hand, with no cables. The BOM, CAD, assembly guide and Python/Arduino demos are on GitHub, and Seeed Studio and WowRobo sell kits.
